rationale: Create one Maverick 6 & 7 portfolio company at the shared Maverick 67 holdco boundary. Munich Re, through its MEAG-managed MR Falcon vehicle, acquired 50% of both underlying California projects on January 18, 2022; EDF Renewables retained the other 50%. Maverick Solar 6, LLC and Maverick Solar 7, LLC are underlying project SPVs and are not counted separately. The reciprocal Maverick 7 queue task is superseded by this consolidated after-image.

supports: Munich Re's current investment-company list retains Maverick 67 HoldCo, Maverick 67 Class B HoldCo and MR Falcon.
The shared holdco structure remains current through the verification cutoff.

evidence.purpose: Acquisition closing, vehicle and stake evidence.
supports: MR Falcon acquired the Maverick 67 holdco interests on January 18, 2022.
The acquisition resulted in a 50% interest in each Maverick 6 and Maverick 7 project company.
EDF Renewables and MEAG announced their partnership across Maverick 6 and Maverick 7.
The projects are located in Riverside County, California and comprise contracted utility-scale solar infrastructure.
Maverick 6 reached full operation with solar and battery-storage capacity.
EDF Renewables remained responsible for long-term operations and maintenance.
Maverick 6 and Maverick 7 remained within EDF's active regulated generation portfolio in 2025.
No subsequent ownership transfer or pending exit was identified through the cutoff.

afterImage.name: Maverick 6 & 7
afterImage.description: Maverick 6 & 7 is a shared California renewable-power portfolio comprising the Maverick 6 solar-plus-storage project and the Maverick 7 solar project in Riverside County. Maverick 6 includes 100 MWac of solar generation and a 50 MW / 200 MWh battery system, while Maverick 7 provides 132 MWac of solar generation. Munich Re, through a MEAG-managed MR Falcon vehicle, owns 50% of each project and EDF Renewables retains the other 50%. The projects operate within CAISO and supply contracted renewable power; their project LLCs are treated as underlying assets rather than separate portfolio companies.
